mapper.select: INSERT INTO implication_rules (id, kb_id, trigger, phrase, subject_type_id, object_type_id, object_is_value, conclude_property_id, reading, status, votes, decided_by, basis, statement_count, examples) VALUES (#{id}, #{kbId}, #{trigger}, #{phrase}, #{subjectTypeId}, #{objectTypeId}, #{objectIsValue}, #{concludePropertyId}, #{reading}, #{status}, #{votes,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.JsonNodeTypeHandler}, 'agent', #{basis}, #{statementCount}, #{examples,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.TextArrayTypeHandler}) ON CONFLICT (kb_id, trigger, phrase, subject_type_id, object_type_id, object_is_value, conclude_property_id, reading) DO UPDATE SET status = EXCLUDED.status, votes = EXCLUDED.votes, basis = EXCLUDED.basis, statement_count = EXCLUDED.statement_count, examples = EXCLUDED.examples, decided_at = now() WHERE implication_rules.decided_by = 'agent' RETURNING id

SELECT id, trigger, phrase, subject_type_id, object_type_id, object_is_value, conclude_property_id, reading, status, votes, decided_by, basis, statement_count, examples, decided_at FROM implication_rules WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND (#{status}::text IS NULL OR status = #{status}) ORDER BY decided_at, phrase

SELECT id, trigger, phrase, subject_type_id, object_type_id, object_is_value, conclude_property_id, reading, status, votes, decided_by, basis, statement_count, examples, decided_at FROM implication_rules WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND id = #{id}

UPDATE implication_rules SET status = #{status}, votes = #{votes,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.JsonNodeTypeHandler}, decided_by = 'person', decided_at = now() WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND id = #{id} RETURNING reading

SELECT DISTINCT r.reading, lower(btrim(regexp_replace(coalesce(oe.canonical_name, s.object_value ->> 'value', s.object_value #>> '{}', ''), '\s+', ' ', 'g'))) AS phrase FROM implication_rules r JOIN facts s ON s.kb_id = r.kb_id AND s.layer = 'open' AND s.invalidated_at IS NULL JOIN entities se ON se.id = s.subject_id LEFT JOIN entities oe ON oe.id = s.object_id WHERE r.kb_id = #{kbId} AND r.status = 'approved' AND r.trigger = 'phrase' AND r.reading IS NOT NULL AND r.phrase = lower(btrim(regexp_replace(s.phrase, '\s+', ' ', 'g'))) AND r.subject_type_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM se.type_id AND r.object_is_value = (s.object_id IS NULL) AND (s.object_id IS NULL OR r.object_type_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM oe.type_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM phrase_readings pr WHERE pr.kb_id = r.kb_id AND pr.reading = r.reading AND pr.phrase = lower(btrim(regexp_replace(coalesce(oe.canonical_name, s.object_value ->> 'value', s.object_value #>> '{}', ''), '\s+', ' ', 'g')))) UNION SELECT DISTINCT r.reading, r.phrase FROM implication_rules r WHERE r.kb_id = #{kbId} AND r.status = 'approved' AND r.trigger = 'kind_word' AND r.reading IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM phrase_readings pr WHERE pr.kb_id = r.kb_id AND pr.reading = r.reading AND pr.phrase = r.phrase)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO phrase_readings (kb_id, reading, phrase, entity_id, value) VALUES (#{kbId}, #{reading}, #{phrase}, #{entityId}, #{value,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.JsonNodeTypeHandler}) ON CONFLICT (kb_id, reading, phrase) DO UPDATE SET entity_id = EXCLUDED.entity_id, value = EXCLUDED.value, answered_at = now()
